name: CDK4/6 Inhibitor (Palbociclib) + Aromatase Inhibitor (Anastrozole)
histology: invasive breast carcinoma (histology-agnostic; includes invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC) and invasive lobular carcinoma (ILC))

biomarkers.note: Endocrine-based regimen: requires HR-positive (ER and/or PR positive) and HER2-negative disease. A CDK4/6 inhibitor combined with an aromatase inhibitor is a category 1, preferred first-line option for HR-positive/HER2-negative recurrent or metastatic disease. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer, BINV-Q.

lineOfTherapy: first-line for HR-positive/HER2-negative recurrent or metastatic breast cancer (aromatase inhibitor plus CDK4/6 inhibitor, category 1)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: HR-positive (ER and/or PR positive) and HER2-negative
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v6.2026, BINV-Q 5 of 15 (HR-Positive/HER2-Negative recurrent/metastatic, Aromatase inhibitor + CDK4/6 inhibitor, category 1)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: for premenopausal patients, an aromatase inhibitor requires concurrent ovarian function suppression (GnRH analog)
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v6.2026, Principles of Endocrine Therapy BINV-N

drugs.name: Palbociclib

provenance.locator: BINV-Q 14 of 15 (Palbociclib 125 mg PO daily on Days 1 to 21)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-Q 14 of 15. Palbociclib 125 mg PO once daily on days 1 to 21 of a 28-day cycle (7-day break). Dose value as stated in the guideline dosing page. ALTERNATIVE CDK4/6 inhibitors: abemaciclib 150 mg PO twice daily continuously on days 1 to 28 is source-stated (BINV-Q 14 of 15 / BINV-M 5 of 10). Ribociclib is also a listed CDK4/6-inhibitor partner, but the metastatic ribociclib dose (600 mg) is NOT present in the provided source extract; if ribociclib is substituted its dose must be VERIFY-ed against a cited source.

drugs.name: Anastrozole

provenance.locator: line 30818 (Fulvestrant 500 mg versus anastrozole 1 mg for hormone-receptor-positive advanced breast cancer, FALCON); line 30165 (anastrozole 1 mg)

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., anastrozole 1 mg (lines 30165, 30818, FALCON first-line advanced breast cancer). Aromatase inhibitor given PO once daily continuously (represented as days 1 to 28 of the 28-day cycle). The three aromatase inhibitors (anastrozole, exemestane, letrozole) have similar efficacy per the guideline (BINV-N); anastrozole 1 mg is the concretely sourced example. If letrozole 2.5 mg or exemestane 25 mg is substituted, that dose is not in the provided source extract and must be VERIFY-ed.

supportiveCare: CBC before starting, at day 15 of the first 2 cycles, then before each cycle (palbociclib neutropenia).
For premenopausal patients on an aromatase inhibitor, give concurrent ovarian function suppression (GnRH analog) per BINV-N.

doseModificationRules.text: Hold palbociclib and resume at a reduced dose per labeling for grade 3 to 4 neutropenia; obtain clinical review.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: line 30818 (anastrozole 1 mg, FALCON, HR-positive advanced breast cancer); line 30165 (anastrozole 1 mg pharmacology)

guideline.locator: HR-Positive/HER2-Negative recurrent/metastatic first-line, Aromatase inhibitor + CDK4/6 inhibitor (category 1), BINV-Q 5 of 15; CDK4/6-inhibitor dosing (palbociclib 125 mg days 1 to 21; abemaciclib 150 mg twice daily) BINV-Q 14 of 15; endocrine therapy principles BINV-N

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for the HR-positive/HER2-negative metastatic endocrine-based regimen: a CDK4/6 inhibitor plus an aromatase inhibitor. Serves subtype #5 (HR-positive/HER2-negative), histology-agnostic across invasive ductal (#1) and invasive lobular (#2) carcinoma. The CDK4/6-inhibitor dose (palbociclib 125 mg PO daily days 1 to 21 of a 28-day cycle) is sourced to Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-Q 14 of 15; the aromatase inhibitor dose (anastrozole 1 mg PO daily) is sourced to DeVita 12th ed. (FALCON, lines 30818 and 30165). Abemaciclib 150 mg twice daily is a source-stated alternative CDK4/6 inhibitor; ribociclib is a listed partner but its metastatic 600 mg dose is not in the provided sources and would require VERIFY if substituted (this is noted in-drug, and the modeled regimen uses only fully sourced doses so no field is set to VERIFY). Continue until progression (cycles null). This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
